In a team this size, nobody is going to hand you a swim lane.Nice to have, not requiredCleanroom experience.ISO 14971 risk management depth.Class III, PMA or combination product exposure.Implantables, sealants, hemostats or hydrogel materials.Why this oneA PMA approved device already selling, and several more in active development.
